cd /src && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, pathlib
pat = re.compile(r'\bgetData\b')
for p in sorted(pathlib.Path('/src').rglob('*.py')):
    s = p.read_text()
    new, n = pat.subn('fetchRecords', s)
    if n:
        p.write_text(new)
        print(f"{p}: {n} replacement(s)")
EOF
echo; grep -rn "getData\|fetchRecords" /src --include=*.py
